facts.text: I was born in New York City.
I consider myself an Indian American.
My parents immigrated to the US in the 1980s.
I am interested in learning about the experiences of Indian immigrants who came to the US in the 1980s.
I am interested in learning more about the cultural traditions and customs of India relevant to my family's heritage.
I am interested in learning more about cultural practices that my parents brought with them when they immigrated to the US in the 1980s.
I want to learn more about my parents' stories and customs.
I want to ask my parents about their experiences growing up in India.
I want to ask my parents what it was like for them to immigrate to the US in the 1980s.
